title: picea alba var. albertiana
intro: Picea alba var. albertiana, commonly known as Albert's white spruce, is a variety of coniferous tree that belongs to the family Pinaceae. It is native to the mountains of western North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The oil extracted from Albert's white spruce has been reported to possess antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions such as wound healing, respiratory issues, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the oil include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and other terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
